errors.text_span: The chart is divided into 20 slices

Other (13%, gray), Breitbart (14%, blue), Drudge Report (8%, green), The Daily Caller (8%, orange), The Huffington Post (7%, red), NPR (6%, purple), Vox (6%, brown), The Guardian (5%, pink), BBC (5%, yellow), RT (4%, light blue), Daily Kos (3%, dark green), National Review (3%, olive green), Daily Mail (3%, red), Real State (3%, lavender), Fox News (3%, blue), CNN (3%, pink), PoliticusUSA (3%, turquoise), Shareblue (3%, magenta)
errors.evidence: Several labels/colors are mismatched: Drudge Report is orange and The Daily Caller is green in the figure, not vice versa; BBC is 4% and gray, not 5% and yellow; RT is 3% and cyan/light blue, not 4%; Daily Kos is 3% and dark blue, not dark green; National Review is 3% and blue, not olive green; Daily Mail is 3% and orange, not red; Real State is not a label in the figure (it is Redstate); Fox News is 3% and red, not blue; CNN is 3% and purple, not pink; Shareblue is 3% and pink, not magenta; PoliticusUSA is 3% and brown, not turquoise.
BBC is labeled 4% in the figure, not 5%.
RT is labeled 3% in the figure, not 4%.
Daily Kos corresponds to a light blue/cyan slice in the figure, not dark green.
National Review corresponds to a blue slice in the figure, not olive green.
Daily Mail corresponds to an orange slice in the figure, not red.
The figure label is Redstate, not Real State.
Fox News corresponds to a red slice in the figure, not blue.
CNN corresponds to a purple/violet slice in the figure, not pink.
PoliticusUSA corresponds to a brown slice in the figure, not turquoise.
Shareblue is pink in the figure, not magenta.

errors.text_span: with no legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or visually emphasized slices; the segments appear to be ordered in a roughly descending size, with no additional visual cues.
errors.evidence: The final clause is awkward and repetitive, but the meaning remains understandable.
